import tomlkit


def test_aot_captures_too_many_keys():
    doc = tomlkit.parse("a.b = 1\nc.d = 2\n")
    aot = tomlkit.aot()
    t = tomlkit.table()
    t["x"] = 9
    aot.append(t)
    doc["a"] = aot
    
    expected_output = """[[a]]
x = 9

c.d = 2
"""
    assert tomlkit.dumps(doc) == expected_output
